question: Which of the following Peninsular rivers flows westward?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

• **Narmada** is one of the major rivers in central India and flows westward.

• It originates from the **Amarkantak Plateau** in the state of Madhya Pradesh.

• The river flows through the states of Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat, ultimately draining into the **Arabian Sea**.

• Narmada is also known as the "Life Line of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat"</stro
